You can return or exchange your item(s) for any reason within 30 days of delivery. Tumble covers the shipping costs for the return, and we make the process easy!

To be eligible for a refund or exchange, items must be in new and sellable condition, with no visible damage, stains, or pet hair. Please note that rug swatches are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged. Additionally, we allow one exchange per item (an exchange of an exchange is not permitted).

To get started, you can visit our Returns/Exchange Center:

US: https://www.tumbleliving.com/pages/returns-and-exchanges
Canada: http://tumbleliving.ca/pages/returns-and-exchanges

You will just need your order number and the email address used for the purchase. Once you submit the form, a prepaid FedEx return label will be emailed to you. You can print it at home or bring the return details to a FedEx Office Print & Ship Center to have it printed there.

If you are looking to exchange for the same size, please make sure to indicate that in the portal. Our team will then confirm if your replacement will ship as a rug cover only or a full set.

Thank you for being with us as a customer. Feel free to reach out with any other questions.
